$comment: Internal MCP server manifest — all servers run on the LAN and are reached THROUGH the gateway (gw.internal), never directly. Auth is injected from a secret-manager via ${VAR}; nothing is hardcoded. See README.md for the gateway + audit setup. Adapt hosts to your intranet.

knowledge-base.description: Read-only search over the on-prem RAG knowledge base (RAGFlow/Milvus). Pairs with the enterprise-rag-query skill.

filesystem-readonly.description: Read-only access to an approved internal document share. No write, no paths outside --root.

ticketing.description: Internal ticketing (e.g. self-hosted Jira/GitLab). Can read and comment; cannot close or delete — keep write scopes minimal.
